note: NOT a hand-rolled corpus re-route. The measurement here was produced by the estate's own gated tool, grocerypply-coverage-batch.ps1 -WhatIfOnly, which edits commodities.json, runs compare-deals, diffs crowns and per-commodity store coverage against a baseline it rebuilt under the CURRENT rules first, counts previously-invisible rows revealed per pattern, runs verify-no-regression for first-match-wins theft, then restores commodities.json and re-runs compare-deals. Two full compare-deals passes over one corpus. A hand-rolled match-lib re-route was attempted first and ABANDONED: New-CommodityMatcher needs -GlobalExclude via Get-TcGlobalExclude and every result it printed was a null-matcher artefact reading '(none)' for every name, which is exactly the false-zero this artifact's positive_control exists to catch.
